    [INPUTS]
    [END_INPUTS]

    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Set self.true_positives to the integer constant 0. RESULT self.true_positives]
            [COMMAND Set self.false_positives to the integer constant 0. RESULT self.false_positives]
            [COMMAND Set self.false_negatives to the integer constant 0. RESULT self.false_negatives]
            [COMMAND Set self.true_negatives to the integer constant 0. RESULT self.true_negatives]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]

MetricsCalculator.update:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Iterate through paired predicted and true binary labels and increment the appropriate confusion-matrix counter for each pair." update]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> predicted_labels </REF>: sequence "Predicted binary labels to compare."
        <REF> true_labels </REF>: sequence "Ground-truth binary labels to compare."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: null "This method updates internal confusion-matrix counters in place and does not return a value."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND For each paired predicted and true label produced by zipping predicted_labels with true_labels, evaluate the label combination in order. RESULT pair_iteration]
            [COMMAND Within the outer loop, if predicted equals 1 and true equals 1, increment self.true_positives by 1. RESULT self.true_positives]
            [COMMAND Within the outer loop, else if predicted equals 1 and true equals 0, increment self.false_positives by 1. RESULT self.false_positives]
            [COMMAND Within the outer loop, else if predicted equals 0 and true equals 1, increment self.false_negatives by 1. RESULT self.false_negatives]
            [COMMAND Within the outer loop, else if predicted equals 0 and true equals 0, increment self.true_negatives by 1. RESULT self.true_negatives]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
MetricsCalculator.precision:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Compute precision by updating internal counts from the label inputs, returning 0.0 when there are no predicted positives, otherwise returning true positives divided by all predicted positives." precision]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> predicted_labels </REF>: unknown "Predicted label values used to update internal counts."
        <REF> true_labels </REF>: unknown "Ground-truth label values used to update internal counts."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: float "The precision value, or 0.0 when there are no true positives and false positives."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Update the internal state using predicted_labels and true_labels. RESULT self]
            [COMMAND Check whether the sum of true positives and false positives is exactly 0. RESULT condition]
            [COMMAND If the sum is 0, return 0.0 immediately. RESULT 0.0]
            [COMMAND Otherwise, compute true_positives divided by the sum of true_positives and false_positives. RESULT precision]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
MetricsCalculator.recall:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Computes recall by updating internal counts from predicted and true labels, returning 0.0 when there are no positive ground-truth instances and otherwise returning true positives divided by true positives plus false negatives." recall]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> predicted_labels </REF>: unknown "Predicted label values passed to the update step."
        <REF> true_labels </REF>: unknown "Ground-truth label values passed to the update step."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: float "The recall value, or 0.0 when the denominator would be zero."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Update the internal evaluation counts using predicted_labels and true_labels. RESULT self.update(predicted_labels, true_labels)]
            [COMMAND Check whether the sum of true positives and false negatives is exactly zero. RESULT self.true_positives + self.false_negatives == 0]
            [COMMAND If the sum is exactly zero, return 0.0 immediately as the default recall value. RESULT 0.0]
            [COMMAND Otherwise, compute recall as true positives divided by true positives plus false negatives. RESULT self.true_positives / (self.true_positives + self.false_negatives)]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: The sum of true positives and false negatives is exactly zero.]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Return 0.0 without performing the division. RESULT 0.0]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
MetricsCalculator.f1_score:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Computes the F1 score by updating internal state, deriving precision and recall, returning 0.0 when their sum is zero, and otherwise returning their harmonic mean." f1_score]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> self </REF>: object "Instance providing update, precision, and recall methods."
        <REF> predicted_labels </REF>: sequence "Predicted label collection used to compute metrics and update state."
        <REF> true_labels </REF>: sequence "Ground-truth label collection used to compute metrics and update state."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: float "The computed F1 score, or 0.0 when precision and recall sum to zero."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Update the internal metrics state using the predicted labels and true labels. RESULT update_state]
            [COMMAND Compute precision from the predicted labels and true labels using the internal precision method. RESULT precision]
            [COMMAND Compute recall from the predicted labels and true labels using the internal recall method. RESULT recall]
            [COMMAND If precision plus recall equals 0.0, return 0.0 immediately. RESULT 0.0]
            [COMMAND Otherwise, return (2 * precision * recall) / (precision + recall). RESULT f1_score]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
MetricsCalculator.accuracy:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Computes classification accuracy by updating internal counts from the inputs, returning 0.0 when no examples have been recorded, and otherwise returning the proportion of correct predictions." accuracy]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> predicted_labels </REF>: unknown "Predicted label values used to update internal statistics."
        <REF> true_labels </REF>: unknown "Ground-truth label values used to update internal statistics."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: float "The accuracy as a floating-point ratio, or 0.0 when the total count is zero."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Update the internal confusion-matrix counts using predicted_labels and true_labels. RESULT _]
            [COMMAND Compute total as the sum of self.true_positives, self.true_negatives, self.false_positives, and self.false_negatives. RESULT total]
            [COMMAND If total equals 0, return 0.0 immediately. RESULT _]
            [COMMAND Otherwise, return (self.true_positives + self.true_negatives) divided by total. RESULT result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: total == 0 after updating counts and summing all four outcome categories.]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Return 0.0 without performing the division. RESULT result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
